description: The bar chart compares the performance of three models—Unsupervised_SimCSE, Supervised_SimCSE, and 2-Tier SimCSE—across three evaluation metrics: Sentiment Accuracy (Sentiment Acc.), STS Correlation (STS Corr.), and Paraphrase Accuracy (Paraphrase Acc.). The horizontal axis lists the three models, while the vertical axis represents the metric value, ranging from 0.2 to 0.8. For each model, three bars are displayed side-by-side, colored light yellow for Sentiment Acc., pink for STS Corr., and light blue for Paraphrase Acc. The chart shows that 2-Tier SimCSE consistently achieves the highest scores across all three metrics, with its Paraphrase Acc. bar reaching approximately 0.8. Supervised_SimCSE follows, with its highest score (Paraphrase Acc.) around 0.78. Unsupervised_SimCSE has the lowest performance, with its highest metric (Paraphrase Acc.) reaching about 0.74. The performance trends across the metrics are consistent for each model, with Paraphrase Acc. generally being the highest, followed by STS Corr., and then Sentiment Acc. The bars are sorted in descending order of performance from left to right.
